evals.name: Primary Capability Execution
evals.prompt: Implement the core functionality of {{SKILL_NAME}} adhering to modern enterprise architecture standards.
evals.expected_output: Production-ready solution with clean modular structure, zero any types, and modern framework patterns.
assertions: Uses current idiomatic framework APIs without deprecated legacy patterns
Enforces strict TypeScript typing with zero any annotations
Includes comprehensive error handling with guard clauses and early returns
Documents public API methods with TSDoc or JSDoc block comments

evals.name: Edge Case & Gotcha Resilience
evals.prompt: Handle unexpected edge cases, reactive state resets, and error conditions in {{SKILL_NAME}}.
evals.expected_output: Robust implementation mitigating known pitfalls defined in the skill's Gotchas section.
assertions: Explicitly handles memory leaks, subscriptions cleanup, or lifecycle unmounting
Validates input boundaries prior to performing business logic
Provides clear recovery or fallback mechanisms for failed operations
